name: zerct
description: Deploy Rust backends and static frontends to Zerct.

scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run typecheck && npm run type-coverage && npm run lint && npm run runtime && npm run pack:dry
scripts.check:source: if find src -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs' \) | grep .; then echo 'packages/zerct must stay TypeScript-only: remove JavaScript files above.' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.lint: oxlint src -D correctness -D suspicious -D perf -A no-await-in-loop --deny-warnings --type-aware --type-check --tsconfig tsconfig.json --promise-plugin --node-plugin --report-unused-disable-directives
